# RemoveLast

Removes the last element of an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
RemoveLast(items)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to remove from, which is left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Array. A new array holding every element of items but the last, in order; the empty array when items is empty or null. Never null.

## Example

`RemoveLast([1, 2, 3])` returns `[1, 2]`.
